builders.angle: LITERAL -- work BRIEF-r41's fix list 1 to 4 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Hedge FIRST (the round's fight, the bottom of both judges' lists twice running). Keep every change inside your four wings.

THE PEN FIRST -- the defect both judges call the family one is un-inked, soft-edged CG props. Prove an inked, broken silhouette with material and a contact shadow on ONE object per wing (a clipped yew wall, a doghouse, an iron bed, a panelled door), then carry that treatment to every object that matters in the four wings, then the floors.

EACH ROOM ITS OWN THINGS -- the judges read this house as 'one set re-dressed': the Foyer's runner in four wings, the Nursery's toys in the Sleeping Quarters, one wood grain down both Passages walls, three primary-colour toy boxes. Give each room objects, floor and wall that belong to THAT room only, drawn and lit, its near floor dressed with them.
